title: Ali Siddiq - Videos
description:
Vulture calls Ali Siddiq “stand-up comedy’s most prolific storyteller,” and audiences know him as one of the best to ever do it. From Houston, Texas, Ali developed his signature storytelling voice during incarceration, where stories were survival and community. Today he’s one of the most watched and viral comedians in the world.
Ali is the first comedian to release a four-part stand-up series — THE DOMINO EFFECT 1–4 — with 50M+ views, ranking him among YouTube’s top comedians. His breakout THE DOMINO EFFECT (18M+ views) and sequels LOSS, FIRST DAY OF SCHOOL, and PINS & NEEDLES continue his run as the internet’s most powerful storyteller.
In 2025 he added MY TWO SONS (10M+) and RUGGED (6M+).  Fans also love his viral classic “Mexicans Got On Boots” (20M+ views) and It’s Bigger Than These Bars (4M+,) cementing his legendary status.
Ali has appeared on The Joe Rogan Experience, Club Shay Shay, 85 South, The Breakfast Club, Kill Tony, VladTV, Your Mom’s House, Good Morning America.
